finding: Shared CortexGroupMove excluded platform declared driving owners and native actor tasks, but vehicleMoveInfo BACK/direct input or simple LEFT/RIGHT did not veto temporary group waypoints. Jink uses this path.
implementation: Existing repeated vehicle gate now deduplicates crew parents, retains all declared platform ownership checks and rejects native BACK/DirectByComander/LEFT/RIGHT for driven ground vehicles. Entry, same-route adoption, before cleanup and final insertion use the same gate. Static/air domain input excluded; no STOP/STOPTURNING issued to qualify.
convoyTrace: ConvoyTick already clamps cruise to0.8 of slowest cached configured top speed, blends measured gaps and lead actual-speed pacing, and retains native endpoints. No further spacing constants changed without live evidence. This finding is route authority, not proof of mixed-convoy flow improvement.
cost: Same group scan boundaries, one vehicleMoveInfo per distinct applicable crew parent per gate instead of per occupant; new native observations, no world query, timer or worker. Actual overhead unmeasured.
limits: A currently owned simple turn must retire before a new shared route can qualify. Same-value replacement and native command quiescence remain unproven. Physical route interruption and mixed-convoy restart failures retained.
validation: Existing focused generation tests extended; full build result in handover.
